chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever maintains his own respect in view, his desires appear light to him.
ai.seo_question: How does self-respect reduce worldly desires according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This maxim from Nahj al-Balagha encapsulates the psychological mechanism of *karam al-nafs* (nobility of the self), where elevated self-worth naturally suppresses base instincts. In Shia ethical tradition, this reflects the principle that true dignity is not merely social status but an internal state that renders worldly temptations trivial, a concept deeply rooted in the Quranic description of the righteous who guard their souls from sin.
